ai_summary_zh: 本場區（玫瑰公園綠地）經3D點雲及高解析地面照片複核，區域內包含鋪面道路、公園人行步道、鐵皮圍籬建物與高密度公園林木。經嚴格核對「無樹幹即非樹木」原則，成功識別並剔除鐵皮牆面、路燈桿、建築外牆及路面等非樹木假陽性標籤。全區完全無水域分布（場區無水域）。
ai_summary_en: 3D point cloud and calibrated ground photo inspection of the site confirm asphalt roadways, brick park pathways, temporary sheet metal wall structures, and healthy park trees. Non-tree false positives including corrugated sheet metal walls, street lamp posts, building facades, and pavement surfaces have been filtered out. The site contains no open water bodies.
